behavior.arguments: rdi = base pointer; sil = input tag byte. The window writes one byte at [rdi+0x10] and returns the byte previously stored there.
behavior.entry_shape: No endbr64, no branches, no calls: cmp $0x2,%sil; sete %al; inc %al; xor %ecx,%ecx; test %sil,%sil; movzbl %al,%eax; cmove %ecx,%eax; xchg %al,0x10(%rdi); ret. The xchg has no explicit lock prefix in its encoding.
behavior.return_rule: Let old = [rdi+0x10] before the window. If sil == 0, store 0; else if sil == 2, store 2; else store 1. Return old. The stored value depends only on sil; the returned value is the previous stored byte.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Thirty-six R_X86_64_RELATIVE records in .rela.dyn name this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries). They are reported as a slot list only; no meaning is claimed for the table they belong to.
